Absorption unconditionally invokes shared teardown and returns true. Teardown uses numeric xF00 == 0 together with nonnull, matching xF04 for fighter notification. The initializer and callback-field definitions independently identify it_802AC3F8 as hit_shield. Its terminal teardown wrapper supports the proposed event name; identical wrapper bodies alone would not establish that identity.
